subject: V1 observation run reconciliation: existing active manifest and scoped remap
body:

INPUT_MANIFEST_v001.json SHA256 8eb386d6a0a500c3fddc88f6676e26a488fbec542ff075d47eb5ea2464950fd6. It was NOT delivered or launched; writes are now frozen. Do not switch your active job to it. Reported remap: LOOK-V3-01 controls outfit only, not face/scene; naturalface visible teeth/traits only where applicable, mouthcrop not wholeidentity/mechanics approval; refs no self-validation. Face-marks/breather/bodybuild reportedly unassigned; grill lock reportedly missing. Please supply actual remap artifact and any existing exact provenance/mappings. Existing optional grill-design candidate is being audited, not promoted. REV means camera-line crossing; accessory tolerances remain scoped; no minus1 bulk rule accepted. Source audit continues independently; CFA input is not a gate.
